notes: Facets are independent; a domain does not establish expertise, modality, rights, compensation, quality or contribution.
Unknown facets remain empty arrays. Membership is a research classification, never source approval.
Workflow edges describe only the explicitly cited stage; no edge is transitive and no capability establishes a particular contribution.
